title: Digital Footprint: Who Are We Online?
statementOfInquiry: Our digital communication reflects cultural identities and shapes the way diverse audiences perceive personal reputation.

inquiryQuestions.factual: What traces of personal data do teenagers leave when using social media platforms?
inquiryQuestions.conceptual: How does digital communication influence real-world relationships and empathy?
inquiryQuestions.debatable: Should parents and schools monitor adolescent online interactions for safety?

criteriaTasks.taskTitle: Podcast: The Psychology of Social Media Likes
criteriaTasks.prompt: Listen to the teen audio interview and identify the speaker's tone, key arguments about dopamine rewards, and implicit biases regarding screen time limits.
Read the multi-modal tech report. Analyze how visuals, headings, and statistical charts work together to persuade youth to protect biometric identifiers.

criteriaTasks.taskTitle: Panel Discussion: Digital Detox vs FOMO
criteriaTasks.prompt: Participate in an interactive debate. Defend your stance on whether a weekly digital detox improves adolescent mental health, using nuanced discourse markers.

criteriaTasks.taskTitle: Blog Post: A Teen Guide to Mindful Tech Use
criteriaTasks.prompt: Write an engaging, structured blog post (200-250 words) offering actionable digital wellness strategies for peers, adopting an empathetic yet persuasive register.

title: AI & The Future: Creativity or Code?
statementOfInquiry: Technological innovation challenges traditional boundaries of human creativity and compels us to redefine authentic intellectual expression.

inquiryQuestions.factual: How do generative AI models produce music, digital art, and essays?
inquiryQuestions.conceptual: To what extent can an artificial intelligence exhibit genuine emotional resonance?
inquiryQuestions.debatable: Does relying on artificial intelligence in school diminish human problem-solving skills?

criteriaTasks.taskTitle: Tech Talk: Generative Art in Video Game Studios
criteriaTasks.prompt: Listen to a game director discuss procedural world generation. Take structured notes on ethical considerations and copyright challenges.
Critically analyze an opinion piece comparing Shakespearean drama with algorithmic story generators. Evaluate the author's figurative language.

criteriaTasks.taskTitle: Pitch: An AI Ethics Guideline for Our School
criteriaTasks.prompt: Present a 3-minute proposal advocating for responsible AI usage in academic competitions and homework tasks.
Craft a speculative narrative about a future classroom where an AI companion discovers human humor. Emphasize sensory imagery and mood.
